# Statics problem sheet

Q1. A beam of length $L$ rests on two supports and carries a point load $W$ at its centre.

(a) Find the reaction at each support.

(b) Find the maximum bending moment.

Solution: Each support carries $W/2$, by symmetry.

Solution: The moment is largest under the load, where it is $WL/4$.

Both answers are in SI units.
